read.text:
The guild-law, cut in the gallery's north wall in letters a hand high, rows of it, each line signed with nine marks. Some lines are worn smooth by fingers. Some are newer, cut over older ones.

EVERY SEAM BELONGS TO A GUILD. EVERY GUILD ANSWERS TO THE TABLE.
WEIGH HONEST. A SHORT WEIGHT IS A THEFT FROM EVERY HAND THAT CUT IT.
NO GUILD OWNS THE BRIDGE.
WHAT THE TABLE SEALS STAYS SEALED.

And lower, older, cut by a less steady hand: DO NOT GO DOWN.
